editorial:
Imagine a world where the FBI has to team up with the world's greatest art thief just to catch another criminal who is even sneakier. That is exactly what you get here. You have Dwayne Johnson playing a straight-laced FBI agent, Ryan Reynolds as a fast-talking thief, and Gal Gadot as a mysterious mastermind. The vibe is basically a high-stakes treasure hunt that takes you across the globe. It feels like a giant party on screen where the main goal is just to have a good time while watching these three clash and compete.

What really works is the chemistry between the leads. The banter is snappy, and the action scenes keep things moving quickly so you never get bored. While the plot is a bit predictable and some of the twists feel a little too convenient, it does not really matter because the energy is so high. If you are looking for a light movie to turn your brain off to, this is it.
endingExplained: You find out that the Bishop and the Booth are actually working together. They tricked the FBI agent to help them find the third golden egg. In the final showdown, they all fight for the treasure, but the art thief and the agent eventually team up to win. The movie ends with the thief and the agent becoming unlikely friends and partners in crime, planning their next big heist together while leaving the bad guys behind.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big stars and easy-to-watch action movies.
